surfaces.rationale: First canonical coverage for bin/janitor's worktree sweep (agentic-zz3k): a closed issue triggers reclamation while the branch is retained as the archive, a dirty worktree whose content equals a reachable commit is removed, content matching no commit is committed to a salvage/ ref before the directory goes, a recently active detached HEAD is left alone, an in-progress issue protects its worktree even when a closed parent epic shares the branch-name prefix, the shared checkout is never a removal candidate, and dry run removes nothing.
